'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**Fifteen people, including eight children, are killed by gunmen in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Ndu, Cameroon|Ndu]], [[Northwest Region (Cameroon)|Northwest Region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cameroon-attack-separatists-8fbd680e37671e02929a9e817b57e9dc (AP)]
*[[Armed conflict for control of the favelas]]
**[[Federal Police of Brazil|Brazilian police]] kill four [[Comando Vermelho]] gang members in a raid in [[Rio de Janeiro]], and seize weapons, ammunition, drugs, camouflage clothing, and radios. A [[Police aviation|police helicopter]] is shot at and damaged, injuring one crew member. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-favela-police-gangs-5df16f5ba67eca32a280f7a2f4968a98 (AP)]
*[[2025–2026 Iranian protests]], [[Kurdish separatism in Iran]]
** Armed groups of [[Kurds in Iraq|Iraqi Kurdish]] fighters, possibly affiliated with the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|PKK]], have allegedly infiltrated the [[Iran–Iraq border|Iranian border]]. According to reports, they engaged in clashes with [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]] led security forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/armed-kurdish-groups-sought-cross-into-iran-iraq-sources-say-2026-01-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/kurdish-fighters-try-exploit-iran-chaos-regional-threat-grows-amid-nationwide-protests (Fox News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Gold as an investment|price of gold]] reaches an all-time high of US$4,644.56 per ounce, surpassing December's previous peak of $4,383.76. [https://www.royalmint.com/gold-price/ (Royal Mint)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Crans-Montana bar fire]]
**The [[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[Cantons of Switzerland|cantons]] of [[Valais]] and [[Canton of Geneva|Geneva]] ban fireworks in indoor venues in the aftermath of the fire at a [[Crans-Montana]] nightclub, which killed 40 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgezqvwr54no (BBC)]
*[[2026 Sikhio train disaster]]
**At least 32 people are killed and 66 others are injured when a [[Crane (machine)|construction crane]] falls onto a passing train in [[Sikhio district]], [[Nakhon Ratchasima province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/thailand-latest-at-least-22-killed-after-crane-falls-on-train-13494030 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-five-killed-after-crane-falls-train-thailands-northeast-2026-01-14/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-train-construction-crane-accident-deaths-4103e4d6806fe007d4e35f5eb9133a97 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Copernicus Climate Change Service]] reports that 2025 ranks as the [[Hottest year on record|third-warmest year]] on record and completes the first three-year period with average global temperatures at least 1.5{{nbsp}}°C above [[Pre-industrial society|pre-industrial levels]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/weather-traffic/2026/1/14/2025-was-third-hottest-year-on-record-eu-us-experts-1312 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–Azerbaijan relations]]
**[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
***[[Azerbaijan]] releases four [[Armenia]]n prisoners convicted of offenses linked to the [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] conflict as part of ongoing [[Armenia–Azerbaijan peace agreement|post-war normalization efforts]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/azerbaijan-releases-four-armenian-prisoners-sign-deepening-peace-2026-01-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Greenland crisis]]
**[[Denmark–France relations]]
***[[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French foreign minister]] [[Jean-Noël Barrot]] announces that [[France]] will open a consulate in [[Greenland]] in February, signaling its rejection of attempts by the [[United States]] to acquire the territory through coercion. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/01/14/france-will-inaugurate-greenland-consulate-in-february_6749409_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[Travel bans under the Trump administrations]]
**The U.S. [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] announces that it will suspend the processing of [[Visa policy of the United States|immigrant visas]] for 75 countries. [[Tourism in the United States|Tourist]] and business visas will not be affected. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/01/14/us-suspends-immigrant-visa-procedures-for-nationals-of-75-countries_6749430_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
